text: Carpentry is a craft that involves shaping and assembling wood pieces to create functional and aesthetically pleasing structures. Varnish is a protective coating that enhances the appearance and durability of wood surfaces by preventing water from penetrating and causing damage. In environments where water may be present, such as kitchens or bathrooms, water is prevented from penetrating the surfaces. The process of applying a varnish over a jointed surface ensures a smooth and glossy finish. Varnish is not just a decorative aspect but also plays a crucial role in maintaining the structural integrity and longevity of the built environment.
